items.note: The CV describes internal Python tooling used by four engineers, which could be read as production use, but it never says production software or data services.
No cloud platform is mentioned as experience; the cover letter explicitly says the work is not production cloud platforms.
Airflow, dbt, Spark and Kafka do not appear in either document.
Only querying and writing to an IT-created staging table is described, with no data modelling or schema design.
Docker is described only as tutorial-based Docker Compose use in a local learning project.
CI/CD is not mentioned in either document.
Automated checks refer to data checks against test specifications, not automated testing of code.
The Flask API is described as a personal project that runs locally on a laptop, not as a production REST API.
PLC programming is not mentioned in either document.
The CV says the online course is in progress with no certificate awarded yet.

items.item: Upgrading Python/MATLAB scripts to 'production Python services' or 'built and deployed data pipelines'
items.note: The scripts are described as internal tooling and scheduled scripts, not as production services or deployed pipelines.

items.item: Describing the Task Scheduler script as an orchestrated ETL pipeline or adding Airflow/dbt
items.note: The Task Scheduler script is described honestly as nightly scheduled execution, with no ETL orchestration or Airflow/dbt claimed.

items.item: Claiming he designed or administered the SQL Server database or did data modelling
items.note: The CV says he queries the SQL Server database and that IT created the staging table, with no design or administration claimed.

items.item: Listing GCP, BigQuery, Docker, CI/CD or Kafka because the ad asks for them
items.note: GCP, BigQuery, Kafka and CI/CD are not listed; Docker appears only as tutorial use.

items.item: Presenting the laptop Flask API or the Docker Compose tutorial as professional backend work
items.note: The Flask API is labelled a personal learning project running locally, and Docker Compose is labelled tutorial-based.

items.item: Calling him a PLC programmer or industrial automation engineer
items.note: He is described as a Test & Validation Engineer and mechanical engineer, not a PLC programmer.

items.item: Listing the unfinished online course as a certificate
items.note: The course is listed as in progress with no certificate awarded yet, and the cover letter says six of nine modules completed.

items.item: Retitling his current job as Data Engineer or Software Engineer, or presenting him as a senior data engineer because of 12 years of engineering
items.note: His current title stays Test & Validation Engineer, and the cover letter does not present him as a senior data engineer.

items.item: Old cover letter is addressed to his current employer and says he works at Halvik Pumps
items.note: The cover letter is addressed to Halden Pay, and Halvik Pumps appears only as a past role in the CV.
